jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international financial services organization with a strong local presence in Belgium. To support its continued growth and digital transformation, they are looking for an IT Coordinator who will act as the key liaison between the local business, international IT teams, and external technology partners.

This is a highly visible role offering a balanced mix of operational service management, stakeholder engagement, governance, and project delivery. Rather than being a hands-on technical expert, you will ensure that IT services are delivered efficiently, compliantly, and in line with both local business needs and international standards.

Jobomschrijving

Application & Service Management

• Act as the primary point of contact for business applications.
• Coordinate IT service delivery throughout the entire lifecycle, including incidents, changes, releases, and performance management.
• Oversee and monitor Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) processes.
• Manage external suppliers, including service levels, contracts, costs, quality, and performance.
• Facilitate collaboration between business stakeholders, international IT teams, and service providers to deliver sustainable and effective solutions.
• Ensure accurate documentation and compliance with group IT governance and control frameworks.

IT Infrastructure, Network & Digital Workplace

• Coordinate infrastructure and digital workplace services in partnership with international IT teams and external vendors.
• Monitor the quality and availability of workplace technologies, including hardware, networking, and telephony services.
• Oversee incident management processes and ensure timely escalation to the appropriate teams.
• Support the alignment of global IT standards and processes with local operational requirements.
• Represent the local organization within international IT communities and initiatives.

Project Management & Product Ownership

• Coordinate and follow up on IT projects involving internal stakeholders and external partners.
• Translate business requirements into practical IT solutions, acting as the bridge between local business needs and the central IT roadmap.
• Ensure successful implementation and delivery of technology solutions within agreed timelines and scope.
• Manage project scope, planning, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with international colleagues and key stakeholders.
• Identify opportunities for process optimization, innovation, and service improvement.

IT Governance, Compliance & Administration

• Monitor IT-related expenditures, invoices, and budgets.
• Contribute to IT risk and control frameworks, including regulatory requirements such as DORA, GDPR, and MiFID II.
• Ensure IT services comply with internal policies and external regulatory obligations.
• Monitor and continuously improve IT processes within the local business environment.
• Serve as a point of contact for audits and compliance-related activities.
• Support Business Continuity initiatives through planning, testing, and safeguarding critical business processes.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through relevant experience.
• At least 5 years of experience in an IT-related role.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft technologies, including SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, Word, and Excel.
• Understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments is considered an asset.
• Strong service-oriented mindset with the ability to coordinate and drive initiatives forward.
• Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
• Able to connect people, facilitate collaboration, and navigate across different levels of an organization.
• Strong organizational and administrative skills with great attention to detail.
• Quality-driven with a focus on service continuity and operational excellence.
• Strong communication and teamwork skills.
• Fluent in Dutch and English; knowledge of French is a strong advantage.

• Fluent in French and English, with strong organizational, communication and strategic thinking skills.

jobs.occupation: Accounting and Reporting Manager in Brussels
jobs.description:
This newly created position combines technical accounting expertise, business partnering and people management, offering the opportunity to build and develop a function with significant visibility across the organization.

You will work closely with a variety of stakeholders while ensuring accurate reporting, financial transparency and high-quality service delivery.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you will oversee accounting and reporting activities for centrally managed costs and third-party managed assets while acting as a trusted finance partner to key stakeholders.

• Partner with central functions such as IT, Legal and other support teams on financial performance and cost management.
• Own the accounting, reporting and control of centrally managed expenditures.
• Manage the reporting and relationship with third-party property owners, ensuring accurate information and timely responses to inquiries.
• Review monthly financial results, analyse variances and provide clear financial insights.
• Coordinate month-end closing activities, reconciliations and intercompany recharges.
• Drive process improvements, strengthen controls and support systems-related initiatives.
• Lead, coach and develop a small team, fostering collaboration and high performance.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent experience.
• Solid accounting background with at least 7 years of experience in accounting and financial reporting.
• Fluent in English with excellent communication skills - French and Dutch
• Previous experience managing and developing team members, with a genuine interest in people leadership.
• Strong business partnering mindset and the ability to build effective relationships with both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
• Experience working in an international, multi-entity or shared services environment is a plus.
• Strong knowledge of SAP; experience with ERP implementations or system improvements is highly valued.

Leading a team of three, you will ensure the smooth running of the procure-to-pay cycle, support internal stakeholders and drive continuous improvements that contribute to stronger controls and faster supplier payments.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you will manage the purchase order administration function and ensure the quality, accuracy and efficiency of related financial processes.

• Lead and support a team of three responsible for purchase order administration activities.
• Ensure purchase orders are created accurately and processed in line with internal procedures.
• Oversee supplier master data management, ensuring vendor information and bank details remain accurate and compliant.
• Maintain product catalogues and ensure pricing, descriptions and accounting information are up to date.
• Act as a key support partner for internal stakeholders, providing guidance on purchase order and supplier administration processes.
• Ensure compliance with approval workflows, financial controls and procure-to-pay procedures.
• Drive process improvements that enhance efficiency and support faster supplier payments.

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent experience.
• Proven experience in Accounts Payable, Accounting, Finance Operations or a similar environment.
• Fluent in English and either Dutch or French.
• Experience leading a team, or the ambition to take the next step from Team Lead to Manager.
• Strong understanding of procure-to-pay processes, purchase orders and supplier data management.
• Hands-on SAP experience is essential.
• A structured and detail-oriented professional with a strong focus on accuracy, controls and process efficiency.

Our client is a European tech group operating across mobility and renewable energy, with several complementary businesses spanning digital media, training, e-commerce, and software.The role focuses on their EV charging platform, a scale-up offering a leading consumer app, a roaming charging solution used across Europe, and a growing B2B SaaS platform for corporate fleets.As part of their international expansion, they are now appointing a Country Manager to build and lead the BeLux market.

Jobomschrijving

As Country Manager, your main responsibilities will be to :

Shape & own the BeLux market strategy

• Define the market vision and priorities for Belgium & Luxembourg, adapting the global framework to local realities.
• Build a deep understanding of drivers, barriers, competitors, and user/company behaviors to inform strategic decisions.
• Identify high-impact growth levers across B2C and B2B.

Accelerate B2C adoption & engagement

• Boost usage of the mobile app and charging access solution through creative, locally relevant activation.
• Work with Marketing on targeted campaigns and growth experiments; ensure seamless onboarding with Customer Success.
• Influence product developments by sharing market insights and feature needs with Product & Tech.

Drive B2B development & support fleet electrification

• Analyze fleet maturity and corporate charging needs to position the B2B SaaS offer effectively.
• Partner with Marketing & Sales to build a solid lead generation engine and qualify opportunities.
• Secure customer satisfaction and long-term usage through close collaboration with Customer Success and B2B Ops.

Turn strategy into execution & measurable results

• Own the BeLux KPIs and P&L: monitor performance, detect weak signals, and propose data-backed improvements.
• Deploy clear action plans and ensure cross-functional alignment for efficient execution.
• Be the operational link between market needs and central teams (Sales, Product, Tech, Marketing, CS).

Build and represent the brand in the local ecosystem

• Become the face of the company in the BeLux market: attend events, engage communities, and expand visibility.
• Develop partnerships with charging networks, installers, service providers, driver associations, and corporate stakeholders.
• Conduct initial discovery visits with prospects, validate opportunities, and coordinate handovers to internal Business Developers.

Prepare the ground for future local expansion

• Identify organizational needs as the market grows and contribute to planning a future local team (Sales, Marketing, etc.).
• Ensure continuous feedback loops to refine positioning, operations, and product-market fit.

The successful candidate will have the following qualities:

• Relevant experience in market development / new market launch / acceleration (ideally in SaaS, digital products, mobility, energy)
• Proven ability to adapt a global strategy to local dynamics and deliver measurable growth.
• Data-driven: confident with KPIs, dashboards, CRM, and translating field insights into action.
• Strong partnership-building mindset with companies, associations, and institutional stakeholders.
• Entrepreneurial, hands-on, and autonomous, with excellent cross-functional collaboration skills.
• Deep understanding of BeLux cultural and business context; EV ecosystem knowledge is a plus.
• Fluent in Dutch and English.

• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
 
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.

• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

Your mission
 

We are looking for a dedicated Weekend Night Receptionist (f/m/d) to ensure smooth and secure overnight operations across our hotels during weekends. If you're detail-oriented, dependable, and enjoy working independently during the quiet hours, this is your chance to make a difference where it matters most. You will be responsible for overseeing the front desk operations during the overnight shift, ensuring smooth and efficient guest service, and performing end-of-day financial reconciliation. This role is a combination of guest service, administrative, and accounting duties, requiring attention to detail, accuracy, and professionalism. This role also includes light food & beverage duties, such as preparing and setting up the breakfast service for early morning guests.

Your profile
 
 

• Previous experience in hotel front office or night audit role preferred 

• Fluency in English and French (Dutch is a plus) 

• Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and financial reconciliation 

• Familiarity with Property Management Systems (PMS); experience with Opera, Opera Cloud is a plus 

• Excellent communication and customer service skills 

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision 

• Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word) 

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail  

Job requirements
 

Key Responsibilities: 

Front Desk Operations 
 
 

• Welcome and check-in late arrivals in a professional and friendly manner 

• Handle guest requests, inquiries, and complaints promptly and efficiently 

• Process check-outs and prepare bills for early departing guests 

• Ensure lobby and reception areas are clean and presentable during the night 

• Follow daily night checklist   

Night Audit and Reporting 
 
 

• Perform nightly audit of all hotel revenue, including rooms, food & beverage, and other outlets 

• Reconcile and balance daily transactions and post any necessary corrections 

• Prepare daily summary reports for management (e.g. occupancy, revenue, etc.) 

• Roll the date in the property management system (PMS) and close the business day  

Security and Safety 
 
 

• Monitor the property to ensure the safety and security of guests and staff 

• Follow emergency procedures and report any suspicious activity to management or security personnel 

• Conduct property walks and ensures all access points are secure  

Cash Handling 
 
 

• Reconcile the front desk cash drawer and ensure all transactions are properly accounted for

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

Are you technically skilled, detail-oriented, and looking for a varied role in a warm, family-owned company? Then this position as Mould Technician could be the perfect fit for you!

In this role, you will be responsible for the correct assembly and disassembly of moulds. Every changeover is carried out with great attention to detail and in line with established procedures, ensuring that all equipment remains in perfect condition. Careful handling and precision are key.

After a thorough onboarding period and once you have gained sufficient experience, you will also be responsible for restarting machines after a changeover. In addition, you will support the mould department with various tasks such as:

• Maintenance and repair of moulds

• Assembling and fine-tuning moulds

• Providing general technical support

• No two days are the same!

• Strong mechanical knowledge is essential

• Able to work very precisely and neatly

• Experience in a similar technical role is an advantage

• Skilled in setting up production machines and tools

• Able to plan efficiently and set priorities, both independently and in a team

• Methodical approach, following procedures with an eye for improvement

• Quick to analyse, report, and adjust when needed

• Positive, constructive attitude

Shape the architecture behind the next generation of AI supercomputers.
 

Join imec and design the future of AI computing
 

What if your architectural decisions could influence the future of artificial intelligence at the scale of the world's most advanced computing systems?

At imec, you will work at the intersection of AI, semiconductor innovation, and large-scale computing architectures. Together with leading experts in computing systems, chip technology, software, and artificial intelligence, you will help define how future AI infrastructure is built, optimized, and scaled.

This is not a product maintenance role. It is an opportunity to explore breakthrough architectures that could shape the next decade of AI and high-performance computing.
 

What you will do
 

As a Principal AI & High-Performance Computing Architect, you will drive innovation across the entire computing stack, from AI applications and system software to processors, accelerators, and semiconductor technologies.

You will create models, simulations, and design explorations that help identify the most promising paths toward future AI computing systems that deliver significant improvements in performance, energy efficiency, and sustainability.

Your responsibilities include:
 
 

• Exploring architectural solutions for next-generation AI and high-performance computing clusters. 

• Analysing the behaviour and performance characteristics of large-scale AI workloads. 

• Developing performance models that identify bottlenecks and opportunities for innovation. 

• Evaluating future processor, accelerator, memory, and system designs. 

• Collaborating with experts in computer architecture, AI, semiconductor technology, system software, and modelling. 

• Defining requirements for future AI computing platforms and processor architectures. 

• Guiding strategic research directions through data-driven performance analysis and projections. 

• Contributing to breakthrough innovations that improve performance, energy efficiency, operational cost, and environmental impact. 

Who you are
 
 

• Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or relevant STEM degree, with at least around 8 years of experience.   

• Experience with performance analysis, engineering, and optimization of HPC applications, such as molecular dynamics and computational fluid dynamics,  

• Experience in AI for HPC is a plus.   

• Experience with distributed AI/ML applications, such as LLM training and inference.   

• Experience in system performance modeling ranging from a single device (e.g. a GPU) to a machine scale (e.g. a cluster).  

• Good understanding of GPU (preferably XPU) system architectures, distributed programming models, runtime resource management, and microarchitecture.   

• Strong programming ability in C++ and Python. CUDA knowledge is considered a plus.   

• Your communication and interpersonal skills enable you to work in a dynamic, distributed team. You actively share experiences and knowledge with colleagues. A history of mentoring more junior engineers and interns is a huge plus.   

• We are looking for your excellent communication skills in English, as you will work in a multicultural team and together with our partners.

This is a challenging Executive Assistant role supporting a Partner in an international environment, requiring strong organizational skills and adaptability. You will play a key role in ensuring smooth operations and providing high-level administrative support. An excellent level of English is required and French or Dutch.

 

Client Details

This international law firm has a well-established Brussels office located in the center of Brussels and easily accessible with public transport. Known for its high standards, collaborative culture and long-term employee retention, the organization offers a working environment where teamwork, professionalism and mutual support are highly valued.

 

 

Description

As a Legal Assistant / Executive Assistant you'll be responsible for:

• Complex agenda and meeting management
• Coordinating travel arrangements
• Managing and monitoring emails and communications
• Preparing and organizing documents and files
• Drafting correspondence and administrative documents
• Time entry and billing support
• Assisting with submissions and document preparation
• Acting as a trusted point of contact for internal and external stakeholders
• Collaborating closely with other assistants and providing mutual back-up support
 

• You have a few years of experience as a management assistant or executive assistant (no prior experience in law firms required)
• You are confident, proactive and you have hands-on approach.
• Highly organized and able to bring structure in a fast-moving environment.
• Strong communicator with excellent English and a good command of French or Dutch.
• Tech-savvy, adaptable and quick to learn new processes and systems.
• Team player who enjoys collaborating with colleagues.
• Comfortable following up on actions, managing changing priorities and taking ownership of responsibilities.

Our client is a major real estate and infrastructure organization managing large-scale public-private partnership projects focused on the development, operation, and long-term maintenance of public facilities.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage a portfolio of approximately 25 building projects, coordinating maintenance activities and ensuring smooth collaboration between clients, contractors, and other stakeholders.
• Act as the main point of contact for administrative, technical, contractual, insurance, and damage-related matters, while mediating conflicts and facilitating mutually acceptable solutions.
• Coordinate maintenance requests, technical inspections, change requests, and interventions through a dedicated helpdesk and ensure proper follow-up with the relevant parties.
• Monitor the technical condition, regulatory compliance, and overall performance of the buildings, including annual condition assessments based on NEN 2767 standards and follow-up of corrective actions.
• Prepare and maintain accurate documentation, meeting reports, and records in the document management system, while supporting stakeholders in improving the energy efficiency of the buildings.

• Bachelor's degree in Construction Engineering, Facility Management, Real Estate, or equivalent professional experience, with 3-5 years of relevant experience in maintenance, technical consultancy, or real estate.
• Strong knowledge of building technical systems and maintenance requirements, ideally gained through experience with schools, offices, hospitals, or other large public/commercial buildings.
• Excellent communication, consultation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to mediate conflicts and build strong professional relationships.
• Proactive, customer-oriented, highly organized, and solution-driven, with strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently as well as within multidisciplinary teams.
• Fluent in Dutch, with a good command of French and English, and proficient in MS Office and technical/construction documentation tools such as CAD and relevant maintenance or project-management applications.

Our client is an innovative SME located in the Maldegem region, specialising in the design, development and installation of high-tech test and measurement equipment for the agricultural sector. Their tailor-made solutions are used worldwide by machine manufacturers, universities and testing centres to accurately test, measure and optimise agricultural machinery. Jobomschrijving

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, you will be involved in the complete development of innovative machines and testing systems. From the initial concept to the final installation at the customer's site, you will play an active role throughout the entire project lifecycle. This is a varied position combining engineering, assembly, testing and international commissioning.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, your responsibilities include:

• Developing and improving new machines and technical solutions.
• Building, assembling and testing prototypes.
• Installing, commissioning and fine-tuning equipment at customer sites both nationally and internationally.
• Analysing technical issues and proposing improvements to products and processes.
• Preparing technical documentation, manuals and work instructions.
• Collaborating closely with colleagues from engineering, production and service departments.
• Providing technical support during demonstrations, trade fairs and commercial activities.

For this positFor this position as Project Engineer Machine Building, we are looking for an all-round engineer who enjoys combining theory with hands-on technical work. You like taking ownership of projects from start to finish and are willing to travel internationally on a regular basis.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, you have:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electromechanics, Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, Machine Building or a related technical field.
• A strong interest in machine building, automation and product development.
• A hands-on mentality and practical approach to engineering.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Willingness to travel internationally for installations and commissioning projects.
• A good command of English.
• Knowledge of Dutch is mandatory.
• A valid Category B driving licence.
